result.answer:
Verdict: SUPPORTED

The paper reports that STEP outperforms the previous best published abstractive model by 0.8 ROUGE-2 on CNN/DailyMail and by 2.4 ROUGE-2 on New York Times [S:9dd61f8b2d83#2]. Since 2.4 is larger than 0.8, the reported gain is larger on New York Times. The paper also states that on NYT, STEP leads significant performance gains (p<0.05) compared to all other models [S:9dd61f8b2d83#3]. The evidence provides gains over the previous best abstractive model, not the underlying absolute ROUGE-2 scores or named baseline scores.

Document Summarization
Selected passages
Table TABREF26 presents results on NYT dataset. Following the same evaluation protocol as
BIBREF36, we adopted the limited-length recall based ROUGE, where we truncated the predicted
summaries to the length of the gold ones. Again, the first and second blocks show results of previous
extractive and abstractive models, respectively. Results of Step are listed in the third block. Similar to
the trends in CNNDM, Step leads significant performance gains (with $p<0.05$) compared to all other
models in Table TABREF26.
